title: Depth bound for gate unfolding
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $g$ be a well-formed gate, and let $t$ assign a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables to each gate argument and polarity. If every circuit $t(a,q)$, for an argument $a$ of $g$ and polarity $q$, has depth at most $B$, then unfolding $g$ with $t$ at any polarity has depth at most $B+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is well formed: its argument list has no repetitions and, if it is a NOT gate, has length one
Every circuit assigned to an argument of $g$ at either polarity has depth at most $B
